note: Worth County, IA has an official county zoning map (amended by 2023-02 ordinance) and a zoning ordinance, but no queryable zoning district service was found. County IT/GIS maps list no zoning layer; the Beacon GIS viewer is parcel-oriented. ArcGIS searches for Worth County and Iowa zoning found only Cerro Gordo's layer. The city of Northwood publishes its zoning chapter only as a PDF code of ordinances; Manly, Hanlontown and Fertile showed no GIS zoning. The Iowa Zoning Guide city layer holds city-level statistics, not district polygons. Zoning exists only as PDF documents.
